metrics.labelled: post hoc; development read; no rollouts; changes no earlier verdict; route chosen by the user, details not reviewed
metrics.mapping: per arm C and A, e = 95th percentile over 20 states of horizontal error after removing the head's mean label shift, median over 3 seeds; T = the same for the mean training label; first match: WITHIN BUDGET iff every head has e <= 0.02 m in both layouts; BEATS A TABLE, OVER BUDGET iff every head has e <= T/2 in the new layout; otherwise NO BETTER THAN A TABLE
metrics.oracle_kept: simulator camera matrices, in both arms; rest height, sizes, yaw and roles untouched
metrics.prediction: both arms BEATS A TABLE, OVER BUDGET; familiar e near 0.02 m, new e near 0.05 m; grasp displacement under 0.02 m familiar, over it new
metrics.states: dev only: N2 main states 4-23, never in training; training on K1-K6 demos 0-39, familiar layout
